text:
Miami Gardens yɛ kurow wɔ Miami-Dade County, Florida, a wɔde bɛyɛɛ 2003 na Hard Rock Stadium wɔ hɔ, a ɛbuee mfe pii akyi wɔ 1987. Municipality a ɛyɛ abofra no wɔ Greater Miami metropolitan area mu, one of the United States' major gateways to Latin America ne Caribbean.

Football culture wɔ Florida corner yi mu bɔɔ Greater Miami metro a ɛsurrounds no ho, ɛnyɛ Miami Gardens suburban locality no. Miami ka most football-passionate markets mu wɔ United States, fervor a ɛyɛ Latin American ne Caribbean diaspora kɛse na ɛde ba. Kurow no wɔ Inter Miami CF, club a Lionel Messi bɛkaa ho wɔ 2023, na ɛroutinely draw blockbuster internationals ne tournaments. Pedigree no wɔ hɔ largely wɔ Hard Rock Stadium, ɛberɛ a 2024 Copa America Final ne 2025 FIFA Club World Cup matches wɔ hɔ. American host cities kakraa bi na ɛde top-flight football heritage yi bɛbrɛ 2026 World Cup, na kakraa bi na ɛde no fa fan base a ɛbɔɔ football traditions of the Americas mu no mu. Wɔ Miami Gardens, kurow a ɛnyɛ mfe twenty akyi, global game no nya one of ne most natural homes.
